mapper.select: SELECT b.id,b.project_id,b.baseline_no,b.baseline_name,b.status,b.difference_count,b.remark,b.created_by,b.created_at,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_baseline_item bi WHERE bi.baseline_id=b.id AND bi.deleted=0) item_count FROM req_baseline b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.deleted=0 ORDER BY b.created_at DESC,b.id DESC
SELECT id,project_id,tenant_id FROM req_baseline WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{baselineId} AND deleted=0
SELECT id,baseline_id,difference_id,snapshot_json,created_at FROM req_baseline_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND baseline_id=#{baselineId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id
SELECT id,project_code,project_name FROM req_project WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 AND review_status <> '已评审'
SELECT * FROM req_difference WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0 AND review_status='已评审' ORDER BY seq_no,id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM req_baseline WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE req_difference SET baseline_id=#{baselineId},updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{differenceId}
UPDATE req_project SET status='已基线',updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{projectId}
